name: Tote

size.label: Size
size.desc: Outer length x width x height. The 600 x 400 footprint and its halves are the modular sizes used across distribution. A stack of totes rises by the height less the 15 mm foot per level.

mass.label: Mass (kg)
mass.desc: Physical mass of the tote and whatever it is taken to hold. An empty 600 x 400 tote is about 2 kg.
